title: Open-restriction compatibility of the comparison adjunction unit with the canonical pullback comparison

source.place: Tag 00WX (lemma-adjoint-sheaves), the presheaf-colimit/sheafification adjunction for continuous functors, applied to the two composite site functors through V_et; the unit normalization is the agent elaboration extracted by the maintainer reader from step 6 of lem-pur-derived-support-comparison-direct-image (normalization of lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback as conjugate of the sectionwise direct-image identity).

proof.text: Write cT and cV for the comparison adjunctions, and r and s for the etale and pro-etale restriction/direct-image adjunctions. Expand gamma = openComparisonRestrictionIso into the etale localization-uniqueness map, the canonical support-site pullback comparison, and the pro-etale localization-uniqueness map. Conjugation carries the two uniqueness maps to identities. The definition of the middle comparison by conjugateIsoEquiv therefore shows that conjugating gamma under cT.comp s and r.comp cV gives the fixed supportSiteComparisonCoefficientDirectImageIso. This is the private lemma comparisonPullbackOpenUnit_conjugate.

source.place: Tag 0B65, lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints, applied to the canonical localization adjunctions; Mathlib CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Mates.lean.

proof.text: Compute the mate of the fixed restriction identity c under s and r. Evaluate it on a pro-etale module sheaf M and an etale object W. Expanding the mate and the restriction adjunctions leaves the composite of the two canonical pullback maps, with identity components from c. Functoriality reduces their equality to the equality of the underlying arrows into the chosen pullback; both projections agree by the pullback lift equations. Thus this mate is exactly supportSiteComparisonCoefficientDirectImageIso. This is comparisonPullbackOpenUnit_directImage_mate, proved componentwise in ModuleCat, so all scalar actions are preserved.

source.place: Tag 00WX, lemma-adjoint-sheaves; localization restriction/direct-image adjunction and its explicit pullback unit and counit.

proof.text: Let alpha be the TwoSquare with natural transformation gamma.hom, and theta the TwoSquare with natural transformation c.hom. Apply the injectivity of mateEquiv s r to compare mateEquiv cT cV alpha with theta. The iterated-mate/conjugate equation identifies the former image with the conjugate computed in step 1; step 2 identifies the latter image with the same direct-image comparison. Hence mateEquiv cT cV alpha = theta.

source.place: Tag 0B65, lemma-transformation-between-functors-and-adjoints, applied to the canonical localization adjunctions; Mathlib CategoryTheory/Adjunction/Mates.lean.

proof.text: The unit_mateEquiv equation for cT, cV and alpha now gives J(etaT_F) followed by c at nuT^*F equal to etaV at JF followed by nuV_*(gamma_F). Compose with nuV_*(a_F), where a is definitionally gamma inverse. Functoriality, gamma.hom_inv_id_app, and the identity laws cancel these factors and give the exact stated equation. No assumptions on nonemptiness or nonzero coefficients enter, so identity and empty immersions, the zero sheaf and the zero ring are included.
